about: Ground-line pins for the uprights ADR 0085 replaced with #288 G1 objects, on each piece's canvas (its frozen rectangle at 1.5 painting px per world px, the sprite geometry/sprites/g1-<id>.webp). Each window holds one table leg's foot, read from the lower envelope: front-left, front-right and back-right. The shop stack (d8) has no ground edge longer than its own crates and is not pinned (ba-dan-projection.test.ts says why).
